description: This PHP class defines a console command for the Symfony framework that extends the functionality of PHP CS Fixer to fix coding standards in the project. It includes configuration options for resetting cache and executing the fixer process, and provides output handling for fixed files or errors.

classes.name: PHPFixCodingStandardsCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command class that automates fixing PHP coding standards using PHP CS Fixer, with options to reset cache and show fixed files.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with description, help, and options (php binary path, reset-cache).

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the process to run PHP CS Fixer, handles cache reset, outputs fixed files or errors, and returns status.
